deployment_limits.statement: These typed host channels are local Rust mpsc ownership transfers, not a new serialized remote B/Root control protocol. A separate-process B service still needs a real integration that brings back original authenticated results/resources. Public types and getters do not supply that integration.

Both Root and daemon establish absolute limits before later work. Later host events, B wait, registration or ACK do not restart the phase deadline; each side's Instant is local, with Root BOOTTIME binding separately enforced.
The explicit phase Startup accepts actual Android Primary and refuses Notes UI/Desktop combinations in this mode. It is not a generic existing primary-profile switch.
The phase remains same agent/cell/principal/process/spawn and requires different actual task data for C. It does not supply cross-owner consumer authorization or cold restart of retained A.

After a real C Outcome the required worker continues under the original deadline; Startup explicitly returns an error even if generic Launch.run returns Ok because final phase-completion/physical-owner-join acknowledgement is absent.

Original matched capacity, cumulative training budget/selective-update equality and known required cost metrics remain exact. Missing/unknown measurements or failed authentication are not converted into NoUpdate.
